people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.
translations.bsb: So you revisited the indecency of your youth, when the Egyptians caressed your bosom and pressed your young breasts.
translations.kjv: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
translations.asv: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in the handling of thy bosom by the Egyptians for the breasts of thy youth.
